newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks climb, buoyed by Wall St gains.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks climb, buoyed by Wall St gains.

text.p: Madrid stocks climbed higher in afternoon trade on Friday, buoyed by gains on Wall Street.
Traders said a number of large sell orders had eaten away at some of the indices' gains but had not prevented them from ending higher.
Volatile movement in prices in the last half hour prompted the stock market's governing body to delay the close.
"The sharp movements in the market in the last moments of the session led us to consider re-opening the market," a spokesman from the Sociedad de Bolsas said.
But the governing body decided against this and the session closed as normal.
The general index ended up 6.10 points, 1.33 percent, to 465.59, while the Ibex-35 index of leading shares closed 70.75 points, 1.35 percent, higher to 5,327.42.
The banking sector benefitted in particular from the strong inflow of funds during the afternoon.
Endesa was the exception, closing down 70 pesetas at 9,050.
Among other individual stocks, Telefonica gained five pesetas to 3,250.
